S1 should require incident logs, periodic reconciliation against service/claims data, and prompt correction of omissions; otherwise the reporting deadlines may not capture the full evidence base. Keep S2 per-model test rates confidential from the general public; if customer notices are negotiated, distinguish hazard/action notices from publishing the numeric failure rate.
